_comment: Thresholds of verify.py. Every entry has a value and the provenance of the value. Edit here only; the scripts read no other thresholds.

outerCorrTolerance_default.provenance: constant/fsiProperties of all accepted cases (read from the case when present)

nOuterCorr_default.provenance: constant/fsiProperties of all accepted cases; the solver aborts (FOAM FATAL) at this limit when allowUnconvergedCoupling is unset

max_fsi_iterations.provenance: an independent audit of the accepted runs (max FSI iterations <= 30)

max_fsi_iterations_from_t.provenance: independent audit recommendation: start-up window (t < 0.25 s, where abs-accepted steps and the 34-iteration M2 combined step occur) excluded

abs_accept_startup_end_t.provenance: independent audits: absolute-tolerance acceptances lie in 0.03-0.34 s; later ones are flagged CONDITIONAL

p_solves_per_continuity.provenance: independent audits: 3.0 with nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 2 (read from system/fluid/fvSolution when present, else 3)

p_final_residual_max.provenance: system/fluid/fvSolution tolerance of p; independent audits: 9.99999e-13

U_final_residual_max.provenance: system/fluid/fvSolution tolerance of U; independent audits: 9.998e-14

final_residual_slack.provenance: relative slack for printed-digit rounding of the final residual

continuity_sum_local_max_radial_flow.provenance: an independent audit rebase for radial/combined (informational): 1.33e-16 in the accepted iterate; 1.24e-15 in non-accepted iterations

contraction_start_t.provenance: start-up excluded up to 0.5 s; an independent audit: 0-0.5 s window GM 0.920 is start-up

contraction_audit_start_t.provenance: applied from 1.5 s; windows between contraction_start_t and this time can only be CONDITIONAL

contraction_window_gm_max.provenance: an independent audit of the accepted runs: geometric-mean contraction of a window <= 0.90

contraction_run_max.provenance: independent audits: no run of >= 3 consecutive steps with contraction > 1 (from the start of the enforced window)

balance_window_max.provenance: independent audits: AM and energy residual per window <= 1e-2. INFORMATIONAL: exceeded in most accepted runs, decreasing with mesh refinement in torsion

linear_finals_startup_end_t.provenance: found while validating: M1 combined p solves stop at maxIter 1000 with final residual ~2e-9 in start-up steps (signals at round-off); report the M3 runs only. Same start-up end as the iteration criterion

primary_qoi.provenance: the primary rotational set of the verification

secondary_qoi_excluded_from_orders.provenance: normal-traction discrepancy, excluded from order claims

torsion_order_band.provenance: measured 1.72-2.07 (nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 2 family, 0-2 and 0-1.8 s); auditor ranges down to 1.68 for H_f

torsion_order_headline_band.provenance: claim boundary wording; QoIs outside are listed, not hidden

combined_floor_band_M3.provenance: the three-mesh combined study: M3 combined max-norm error 3.1e-3 (alpha_B), 4.3e-3 (T_B), 5.2e-3 (sig_rt), 3.1e-3 (T_A), 3.06e-3 (H_f). The floor statement 'about 2.5-5.2e-3' holds only for these five quantities; 2.5e-3 is the lower edge of the band, the lowest measured value is 3.06e-3 (H_f). Not for H_s (6.9e-3), w_wall (6.3e-3), KE_s (1.06e-2), P_wall (4.8e-2)

combined_self_order_band.provenance: the three-mesh combined study self-convergence: sharp for alpha_B (1.97) and H_f (1.94); nominal 2.00 (T_B), 1.97 (sig_rt), 2.09 (T_A) with noise-limited intervals 1.39-2.60, 1.39-2.54, 1.63-2.55. The band is a qualifying range, not a proof of order

band_conditional_margin.provenance: outside a band by less than this fraction: CONDITIONAL; further: FAIL

combined_second_order_qoi.provenance: the three-mesh combined study (0-2 s): self-orders 1.97, 2.00, 1.97, 2.09, 1.94, of which only alpha_B (1.96-1.97) and H_f (1.93-1.94) have sharp intervals while T_B, sig_rt and T_A are noise-limited (1.39-2.60, 1.39-2.54, 1.63-2.55); the other primary QoIs are not second order (H_s 1.63, w_wall 1.66, P_wall 0.70) and are reported as such

layerB_deterministic._comment: DETERMINISTIC scientific bands from the accepted results. They are not widened to make a result pass. Statuses derived from them are further qualified by the numerical-noise section.

numerical_noise._comment: NUMERICAL-NOISE allowances (decomposition, restart and iteration noise), kept apart from the deterministic bands. They only qualify or downgrade: a value inside a deterministic band but closer to an edge than the allowance cannot be reported PASS (CONDITIONAL), and an allowance never creates a PASS. One consistent statement: the noise of a max-norm error is about 2.4e-4 of max|ref| for the torsion runs and about 1.3e-3 of max|ref| for the combined runs (torque 1.26e-3, shear 1.21e-3, T_A 8.9e-4; rotation and angular momentum are three orders smaller). The audits' '~1e-3 torque/shear band' is the combined-run value.

torsion_max_norm_noise_of_E.provenance: the M3 torsion run against its earlier attempt torque 1.8e-4 (an independent audit of the M3 torsion run); a restarted M3 torsion run against its earlier attempt 2.4e-4 (restart noise floor); an independent audit of the M1 and M2 torsion runs: torque-level difference up to 1.8e-4 on M3, high-pass torque error <= 1.6e-4. Fractions of max|ref|; TORSION runs

combined_max_norm_noise_of_E.provenance: serial vs 4-rank M2 combined (n = 0 pilot): T_B 1.26e-3, sig_rt 1.21e-3, T_A 8.9e-4 of max|ref| (an earlier serial-against-4-rank comparison of an M2 combined pilot); the absolute-tolerance test run against its baseline (absTol 1e-12 -> 1e-10): T_B 8.8e-4, sig_rt 8.6e-4, T_A 5.8e-4 (recomputed from the raw series of the runs). Fractions of max|ref|; COMBINED runs; the generic value for torque/shear-type quantities

scotch_partition.provenance: two fresh decompositions of the same M3 mesh differ; the accepted M3 torsion and combined runs used different partitions

pressure_solver_cap_steps.value: 51 p solves at maxIter 1000 in t = 0.0275-0.0325 s of every radial/combined run
pressure_solver_cap_steps.provenance: an independent audit of the pressure-solver cap: |p| 1e-16 to 1e-13 of max, 0.8-1.7% of run time, immaterial

noise_E_by_qoi_combined.provenance: fractions of max|ref| of the combined runs: T_B 1.26e-3 (serial vs 4 ranks; rounded up to 1.3e-3; the absolute-tolerance test run change 8.8e-4); sig_rt 1.21e-3 (serial vs 4 ranks; the absolute-tolerance test run 8.6e-4); alpha_B max(3.4e-6 serial vs 4 ranks, 5.7e-6 the absolute-tolerance test run change); H_f max(1.1e-5 serial vs 4 ranks, 6.9e-6 the absolute-tolerance test run change)

mixed_term_allowance.formula: allowance(d_q) = noise_E_by_qoi_combined[q] x max|q_ref, combined| / max|mixed-term reference signal|   (error/signal units)

magnitudes_from_reference_json.units: T_B, H_f per radian per metre of depth (N m m-1 rad-1); sig_rt in Pa; alpha_B in rad

torsion_member_in_quadrature.note: adding the torsion member (2.4e-4 x max|q_ref, torsion|) in quadrature changes the allowance by 1.6% and 2.3%; not used, reported for completeness

mixed_term_allowance.cross_check_absolute_tolerance_test_run: changing the absolute tolerance on M2 (the absolute-tolerance test run against its baseline) moves d_T by 5.35e-3 and d_sig_rt by 4.0e-3 of the signal, below the allowances

order_uncertainty.method: first-order propagation: sigma_p23 = (1/ln 2) sqrt((delta/E2)^2 + (delta/E3)^2), first pair analogously; interval = nominal +/- sigma; delta = the max-norm noise of the family (torsion_max_norm_noise_of_E or combined_max_norm_noise_of_E, in units of max|ref|). Self-orders: delta replaced by sqrt(2) delta on the differences d12, d23. The worst-case combination (+/- delta on every error) is also reported.
order_uncertainty.provenance: reproduces the audit's T_B 1.76-2.13 (second pair, torsion, 0-2 s: 1.75-2.13). L2-in-time orders: the noise is documented only in the max-norm, so no L2 interval is given.

noise_limited_halfwidth.provenance: an order interval whose half-width exceeds 0.15 is labelled noise-limited in the driver output: the torsion torque-type orders (+/-0.19 to +/-0.31) and the combined torque, shear and T_A self-orders (+/-0.46 to +/-0.60) exceed it, alpha_B and H_f (+/-0.01) do not

noise_E_by_qoi.provenance: fractions of max|ref|, max-norm. Torsion: the M3 torsion run against its earlier attempt alpha 4.9e-7, H_f 8.6e-7, torque and shear 1.8e-4; the M3 torsion run against a restart alpha 6.9e-7, torque 2.2e-4; a restarted M3 torsion run against its earlier attempt torque 2.4e-4 (an independent audit of the M3 torsion run and an independent audit of the earlier M3 restarts); quantities without a measurement (T_B, sig_rt, T_A, H_s, w_wall, P_wall, KE_s) use the torque value 2.4e-4. Combined: serial vs 4 ranks (an earlier serial-against-4-rank comparison of an M2 combined pilot) T_B 1.26e-3, sig_rt 1.21e-3, T_A 8.85e-4, P_wall 6.4e-4, w_wall 1.13e-4, H_s 9.8e-6, H_f 1.11e-5, alpha_B 3.4e-6; the absolute-tolerance test run against its baseline alpha_B 5.7e-6, H_s 1.2e-5, H_f 6.9e-6, w_wall 8.7e-5, T_B 8.8e-4; KE_s unmeasured: default 1.3e-3

family_consistency._comment: Checks done before any spatial-convergence or mixed-term assessment, from the actual dictionaries (never from metadata).

expected_mesh_ntheta_nrs_nrf.provenance: study meshes; refinement ratio 2 per level

documented_absTol_by_mesh.provenance: accepted runs; effect bounded on M2 only (the absolute-tolerance test run against its baseline), M3 not bounded -> CONDITIONAL

drives.provenance: checked by recomputing the tables with rt_reference.py and comparing with constant/timeVsAngle and constant/pcTable

table_relative_tolerance.provenance: tables are written with 12-17 significant digits

documented_benchmark_settings.provenance: constant/fsiProperties, solidProperties, mechanicalProperties, fluid dictionaries and system/fluid/fvSolution of the accepted runs (identical in all; read from an accepted M1 combined run and the tutorial's stored set)

value.p_solver: maxIter 1000 minIter 1 relTol 0 smoother GaussSeidel solver GAMG tolerance 1e-12
value.U_solver: minIter 1 preconditioner DILU relTol 0 solver PBiCG tolerance 1e-13

documented_solver_text.provenance: system/fluid/fvSolution of the accepted runs (comments and whitespace normalised)

documented_code_hashes.provenance: sha256[:16] of the whitespace- and comment-normalised #{ #} blocks (case paths do not occur in them). current: M1, M3 accepted runs and the tutorial; legacy: the M2 accepted runs (seed 0 => identical boundary values, an independent audit of the legacy diagnostics and the seed-0 pressure code)

documented_fingerprints.provenance: semantic fingerprint (canonical form of the parsed dictionary: comments, whitespace, number formats and entry order ignored; code blocks, the absolute tolerance value masked) of each small dictionary; identical in the accepted M1, M2, M3 runs and the tutorial's stored set

documented_controlDict.provenance: canonical form (semantic, order- and comment-insensitive) of the controlDict of the accepted runs: every top-level entry before and after the functions block except endTime and writeInterval, the function-object parameters, and the hashes of the normalised function-object code (current: M1 and M3 runs; older serial-only version: M2 runs)

documented_geometry.provenance: geometry of the benchmark: solid ring A <= R <= B, fluid B <= r <= c, depth 0.1 m (all vertex and arc radii of the blockMeshDicts)

documented_mesh_fingerprints.provenance: semantic fingerprint of vertices, arcs, block topology and patch definitions of the blockMeshDicts (cell counts excluded); identical for the three meshes of every accepted run
